content.rendered:
Last updated: 09 December 2025
Yalla Together (“we,” “our,” or “us”) is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring a safe and transparent experience while visiting our website.

This Privacy & Cookies Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information in accordance with applicable UAE data protection standards.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

1.1. Information You Provide Directly

* Email address (e.g., when subscribing to our newsletter or contacting us)
* Name (optional, if you choose to share it)
* Any content you submit via forms, messages or comments

1.2. Automatically Collected Data

When you visit our website, certain information is automatically collected, such as:

* IP address
* Browser type and version
* Device information
* Pages viewed and time spent on the site
* General location data (non-specific)

This data is collected through cookies, analytics tools and server logs.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

* Improve our website and user experience
* Send newsletters or updates (only when you opt in)
* Respond to inquiries or comments
* Analyse traffic patterns and website performance
* Maintain website security and prevent misuse

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal data.

3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us understand how you use our website.

3.1. Types of Cookies We Use

* Essential Cookies – Required for basic site functionality.
* Analytics Cookies – Help us understand visitor trends through tools like Google Analytics.
* Preference Cookies – Remember your settings and improve browsing experience.

3.2. Managing Cookies

You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website.

4. Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party services to enhance your experience, such as:

* Email marketing platforms
* Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics)
* Social media embeds

These providers have their own privacy practices, and we recommend reviewing their policies when interacting with embedded content.

5. Data Storage and Security

We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to keep your personal information safe, including:

* Secure servers
* Limited access controls
* Regular website monitoring

Despite our efforts, no digital transmission or storage method is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

6. Your Rights

Subject to UAE data protection principles, you may:

* Request access to the personal information we hold about you
* Request corrections or updates
* Request deletion of your personal data (where applicable)
* Withdraw consent for email communications at any time

To exercise your rights, email us at: hello@yallatogether.com.

7. Data Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this Policy or as required by law.

Email newsletter data is retained until you unsubscribe. Analytics data is retained according to the policies of our analytics providers.

8. Links to External Websites

Yalla Together may include links to third-party websites.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. We encourage you to review their policies when visiting them.

9. Children’s Privacy

Yalla Together does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
If you believe such information has been provided, please contact us so we can remove it.

10. Policy Updates

We may update this Cookies and Privacy Policy from time to time.
Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

11. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Policy or how your data is handled, please contact us at:

Email: hello@yallatogether.com
Website: yallatogether.com

content.rendered:
Yalla Together, is where thoughtful moments are transformed into beautifully curated experiences, to help celebrate connections with intention, creativity, and care.

Our Promise

To make gift-giving joyful, meaningful, and stress-free by building a community that values empathy and celebration. We are forever inspired by the talented artisans and small brands whose sole purpose is to help fulfill the dreams and aspirations of this very community.

The Big Idea

To become the most trusted and inspiring gift guide, where everyone can find meaningful ideas always and forever.

The Heart of Giving

Thoughtfulness: Every recommendation is chosen for its beauty, provenance, and ability to create memories.
Simplicity: Looking for the perfect present shouldn’t feel like a chore. It should be enjoyable.
Inspiration: We aim to spark creativity with every gift.
Community: Independent creators of unique and ethical products come together with people who care for each other and their planet.

Get involved:

Join our Instagram community as we share bi-weekly roundups and handpicked collections designed to make your next gift the best one yet.

Are you a maker or small business owner? We love hearing from creators. Tell us your story and why it would make a great gift.

Share with us your best gift ideas to date and what it meant to others.
